tweets.text: Jack Mallers is out as CEO of Twenty One Capital — resigned effective July 20, took a $420K RSU cash-out, and XXI dropped the planned Strike acquisition. The Tether/SoftBank Bitcoin treasury play just lost its loudest evangelist.

Hut 8 signed a second $9.8B lease at Beacon Point, doubling its AI tenant to 704 MW. Total campus value: $19.6B. Portfolio-wide contracted AI capacity: 949 MW. This company mined bitcoin two years ago.

Greenidge Generation renamed itself Vulcan Infrastructure and Power, changed its ticker from GREE to VIP, raised $39.4M — and used $33M of it to retire debt. The bitcoin miner that no longer wants to be a bitcoin miner.

BIP-360's quantum-resistant wallet spec got a 54-file recut: all Rust and JS reference code deleted. What remains is a single 427-line Python example. Post-quantum Bitcoin is being distilled to its simplest reviewable form.
